g.text: I wanted to send over a quick note on how Q1 went, since the department finished
the quarter with a 2% increase in profits and I think that's worth calling out
properly rather than leaving it for the next review.
A good part of this came from the changes we put in place around scheduling and
stock ordering, which cut down on the wasted hours we were seeing back in February.
Because of this, I feel the department is in a stronger position heading into Q2,
and I'd like to keep building on it if that fits with what you've got planned for
Let me know if you want to go over the numbers together at some point.
